\hat{\mu}(X_{T+1}) + \hat{q}_{1-\alpha} ight]4. 假设解耦：可交换性 vs. 时序相关性共形预测的理论有效性高度依赖样本间的对称性，时序场景下“平稳性”与标准共形推断所需的“可交换性”存在本质分歧。可交换性假设（Exchangeability Assumption）定义：随机变量序列 (Z_{T_0+1}, \dots, Z_T, Z_{T+1}) 的联合概率分布在任意排列 \pi 下保持不变：P(Z_{\pi(T_0+1)}, \dots, Z_{\pi(T+1)}) = P(Z_{T_0+1}, \dots, Z_{T+1})理论推导逻辑：当得分序列 \{S_t\}_{t=T_0+1}^{T+1} 满足可交换性且分布连续时，待测点得分 S_{T+1} 在全集合排序中的排名对称且服从离散均匀分布：P\left( S_{T+1} 	ext{ 在 } \{S_{T_0+1}, \dots, S_{T+1}\} 	ext{ 中排第 } k 	ext{ 位} ight) =  rac{1}{n+1}, \quad  orall k \in \{1, \dots, n+1\}由此可直接推导出无分布假设的严格有限样本边际覆盖率下界：P(Y_{T+1} \in C(X_{T+1})) \ge 1 - \alpha时序依赖与平稳性假设（Temporal Dependence & Stationarity）平稳性的局限：严平稳性仅保证联合分布对于纯时间平移不变，即 (Y_t, \dots, Y_{t+k}) \stackrel{d}{=} (Y_{t+	au}, \dots, Y_{t+k+	au})。但这并不等价于任意排列不变性（可交换性）。自相关破坏置换对称性：非退化平稳序列（如自回归过程 Y_t = \phi Y_{t-1} + \epsilon_t，\phi 
eq 0）具备显著的序列自相关性，即 \operatorname{Cov}(Y_t, Y_{t+k}) 
eq \operatorname{Cov}(Y_t, Y_{t+m}) (k 
e m)。因此对时间标签进行乱序置换会直接改变联合分布测度：(Y_1, Y_2, Y_3) \stackrel{d}{
eq} (Y_2, Y_1, Y_3)对共形排名的冲击：由于残差继承了底层过程的时序自相关性与聚集效应，S_{T+1} 强烈依赖于 S_T 及临近时刻的残差状态，S_{T+1} 的相对排名不再均匀。在有限样本下，标称覆盖率 P(Y_{T+1} \in C(X_{T+1})) \ge 1 - \alpha 不再严格成立，可能出现局部连续失保（under-coverage）或过度保守。时序条件下的理论与算法修正弱依赖渐近保证（Mixing Conditions）：在假定时序过程满足几何衰减的 \alpha-mixing 或  eta-mixing 弱相关条件下，利用分块（blocking）技术可证明覆盖率满足渐近逼近，但有限样本下会引入依赖于混合系数衰减速率的误差界。自适应在线校准（Adaptive Conformal Inference, ACI）：放弃严格的无偏可交换假设，改为通过在线更新机制动态调整名义分位数水平：\alpha_{t+1} = \alpha_t + \gamma \left( \alpha - \mathbb{I}(Y_t 
otin C_t(X_t)) ight)其中 \gamma > 0 为步长，利用在线梯度下降式的反馈回路控制长程平均失保率，以应对序列自相关与局部漂移。

turns.prompt: Derive a blocked calibration scheme and carefully distinguish guarantees under stated assumptions from empirical coverage. Show how block length, calibration size and drift affect the interval.
turns.response:
1. 分块校准机制推导（Blocked Calibration Scheme）在平稳标量时序设定下，设观测残差（不一致性得分）序列为 \{S_t\}_{t=1}^n。为利用弱依赖时序的渐近独立性并保留局部的序列相关结构，采用伯恩斯坦分块技术（Bernstein's Blocking Technique）构建校准集。1.1 分块划分与隔离设计将容量为 n 的校准序列划分为 B 个长度为 l 的“大块”（用于估计经验分布），并在大块之间插入长度为 g 的“缓冲区”（Buffer，用于衰减时序记忆）。满足：n = B \cdot l + (B - 1) \cdot g定义第 b 个校准块的索引集合 \mathcal{I}_b 为：\mathcal{I}_b = \left\{ (b-1)(l+g) + 1, \, (b-1)(l+g) + 2, \, \dots, \, (b-1)(l+g) + l \right\}, \quad b \in \{1, \dots, B\}待测目标时刻为 T+1。为切断校准集尾部与测试点之间的强依赖，测试点前同样保留长度为 g 的隔离间隔，待测点得分为 S_{T+1}。1.2 分块经验测度与统计量每个块 \mathcal{I}_b 内保留完整的局部时序自相关轨迹。定义块级经验经验分布函数（Empirical CDF）：\hat{F}_{b}(s) = \frac{1}{l} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{I}_b} \mathbb{I}(S_t \le s)全校准集加权经验分布定义为各块测度的平均：\hat{F}_{n, l}(s) = \frac{1}{B} \sum_{b=1}^{B} \hat{F}_b(s) = \frac{1}{B l} \sum_{b=1}^{B} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{I}_b} \mathbb{I}(S_t \le s)若预测目标为单个标量值，可在经验测度上加入有限样本有限依赖修正项 \eta(B, l, g)；若预测目标为未来长度为 l 的连续轨迹，则可直接采用块最大值统计量 M_b = \max_{t \in \mathcal{I}_b} S_t 构建标量化分位数。针对标量预测，构造带保守性补偿的修正分位数水平：\tau = (1 - \alpha) + \eta(B, l, g)其中 \eta(B, l, g) 为由集中不等式确定的有限样本覆盖补偿项。校准分位数定义为：\hat{q}_{1-\alpha} = \inf \left\{ q \in \mathbb{R} : \hat{F}_{n, l}(q) \ge \tau \right\}预测区间仍表达为：C(X_{T+1}) = \left[ \hat{\mu}(X_{T+1}) - \hat{q}_{1-\alpha}, \; \hat{\mu}(X_{T+1}) + \hat{q}_{1-\alpha} \right]2. 假设条件下的理论保证 vs. 经验覆盖率辨析2.1 依赖假设条件该分块推导依赖以下严格数学假设：严平稳性（Strict Stationarity）：对任意时间位移 k 与任意子集，联合分布满足 (S_{t_1}, \dots, S_{t_m}) \stackrel{d}{=} (S_{t_1+k}, \dots, S_{t_m+k})。绝对正则弱相关（\beta-Mixing / Absolute Regularity）：混合系数满足几何衰减：\beta(k) = \sup_t \mathbb{E} \left[ \sup_{A \in \sigma(S_u, u \ge t+k)} \left| P(A \mid \sigma(S_u, u \le t)) - P(A) \right| \right] \le C_{\beta} \rho^k, \quad \rho \in (0, 1)2.2 理论保证的形式在 i.i.d. 或可交换性设定下，共形预测提供精确的有限样本无分布下界：P(Y_{T+1} \in C(X_{T+1})) \ge 1 - \alpha。但在弱依赖时序设定下，该下界转变为带耦合惩罚项的渐近松弛界：依据 Berbee 耦合引理（Berbee's Lemma），存在一个独立随机序列块 \{\widetilde{\mathcal{I}}_b\}_{b=1}^B，使得每个 \widetilde{\mathcal{I}}_b \stackrel{d}{=} \mathcal{I}_b，且其与真实序列的总变差距离受缓冲长度控制：P\left( (\mathcal{I}_1, \dots, \mathcal{I}_B) \neq (\widetilde{\mathcal{I}}_1, \dots, \widetilde{\mathcal{I}}_B) \right) \le B \cdot \beta(g)利用块独立代理变量应用 Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz (DKW) 不等式，在置信度 1 - \delta 下，边际覆盖率满足：P(Y_{T+1} \in C(X_{T+1})) \ge 1 - \alpha - \mathcal{O}\left( \sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{B}} \right) - \mathcal{O}\left( B \cdot \beta(g) \right)理论保证的本质特征：无精确有限样本性：无法消除依赖衰减系数导致的不可积残余误差。双重渐近性：唯有当 B \to \infty 且 g \to \infty（使得 B \beta(g) \to 0）时，覆盖率才渐近收敛至名义水平 1 - \alpha。2.3 经验覆盖率的偏离机理在有限时序样本的实际运行中，经验覆盖率与理论保证存在显著分歧：失保聚集性（Miscoverage Clustering）：理论上讨论的是无条件期望（边际覆盖率）。但在实际自回归与条件异方差过程中，指示变量序列 I_t = \mathbb{I}(Y_t \notin C(X_t)) 具备高度正自相关性。一旦系统进入高波动区，经验失保会以“连击”形式爆发，导致局部条件覆盖率远低于 1 - \alpha。边界截断偏差：测试点 T+1 必然紧跟在训练与校准序列之后，即使保留了缓冲距离 g，长程记忆过程（如分数自积或重尾扰动）仍会导致测试点的条件分布与经验测度 \hat{F}_{n, l} 产生偏离。3. 块长度 l、校准规模 n 与分布漂移（Drift）对区间的影响3.1 块长度 l 的偏差-方差权衡固定校准样本量 n，缓冲期 g 固定：l 过小（l \to 1）：机制：当 l 接近 1 时，分块退化为标量独立采样假设。每个块无法容纳时序自相关结构的完整衰减期，导致块间相关性未被有效吸收，破坏了耦合独立性假设。对区间的影响：低估了统计量方差，分位数 \hat{q}_{1-\alpha} 偏小，区间过窄，引发系统性经验欠覆盖（Under-coverage）。l 过大（l \to n）：机制：块内相关性被充分保留，但有效独立块数量 B \approx n/l 急剧下降。对区间的影响：经验分位数估计器的方差膨胀，其不确定性按 \mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{B}) 递增。为了在有限样本下取得理论安全界，修正项 \eta(B, l, g) 被迫大幅放大，导致区间异常宽且高度不稳定（波动大）。最优阶数平衡：在几何 \beta-mixing 条件下，最优块长度通常满足 l^* \asymp n^{1/3} 至 n^{1/2}，缓冲距离满足 g^* \asymp \log n。3.2 校准集规模 n 的渐近收敛区间宽度的渐近紧致：
随 n \to \infty，可在保持 l \to \infty 的同时令 B = n/(l+g) \to \infty。经验分布函数 \hat{F}_{n, l} 一致收敛于真实边际累积分布函数 F_S。覆盖率间隙的衰减：
耦合误差项 B \beta(g) 与方差项 \sqrt{1/B} 同步收敛至 0。区间宽度单调收敛至理论最优预言机区间（Oracle Interval）：\hat{q}_{1-\alpha} \xrightarrow{P} q^*_{1-\alpha} = F_S^{-1}(1 - \alpha)有限样本下的超额保守余量（Over-conservatism）被消除，区间在维持真实覆盖率稳定的前提下达到最小平均宽度。3.3 分布漂移（Concept / Distribution Drift）的破坏机制当时间序列打破严平稳假设，底层数据生成机制随时间发生漂移：设历史校准分布为 P_{\text{cal}}，待测时刻分布为 P_{T+1}，二者总变差距离为 d_{\mathrm{TV}}(P_{\text{cal}}, P_{T+1}) = \sup_A |P_{\text{cal}}(A) - P_{T+1}(A)| \le \Delta。对覆盖率下界的直接削减：
依据非交换共形推断的变差界限，覆盖率下界线性衰减：P(Y_{T+1} \in C(X_{T+1})) \ge 1 - \alpha - \text{Penalty}(n, l) - 2 \Delta方差漂移（波动率扩张）的影响：
若漂移表现为条件方差放大（例如 \sigma_{T+1}^2 = (1 + \gamma) \sigma_{\text{cal}}^2，\gamma > 0）：
由于 \hat{q}_{1-\alpha} 完全基于历史较低波动率构建，区间宽度固定落后于当前的真实波动尺度，经验覆盖率发生断崖式下跌，且覆盖率损失与波动比率 \sqrt{1+\gamma} 成比例。样本量 n 的“负效应”反转：
在平稳场景下，n 越大越优；但在存在连续漂移的场景下，历史越久远的数据（较早的块）与测试点之间的 d_{\mathrm{TV}} 越大。过大的 n 会将陈旧、失效的误差结构固化在校准集内，导致区间对当前时序突变的感知产生严重时滞。此时必须引入时间衰减权重（Locally Weighted Conformal Inference）或限制有效校准窗口。

turns.prompt: Provide complete runnable Python with NumPy to generate an AR(1) process, fit a rolling forecast, calibrate blocked residual intervals and report coverage and interval width. Include Markdown tables of configurations.
turns.response:
1. 实验参数配置下表列出生成自回归过程、模型拟合、分块划分及漂移测试所采用的超参数：参数类别变量符号实验取值物理含义 / 设定说明数据生成过程 (DGP)\phi0.70平稳 AR(1) 自回归系数 (|\phi| < 1)\sigma_{\text{base}}1.00稳态白噪声标准差 \epsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)T_{\text{total}}2400序列总长度（包含训练、校准与测试序列）数据切分T_{\text{train}}600用于 OLS 拟合自回归参数的训练样本容量T_{\text{cal}}600残差不一致性得分校准样本容量 nT_{\text{test}}1200滚动评估测试步数共形校准超参数1 - \alpha0.90目标名义边际覆盖率 (\alpha = 0.10)l1, 10, 30考察的块长度对比梯度（涵盖退化点与大块）g0, 4, 8衰减自相关的缓冲隔离间距 (Buffer Gap)分布漂移设定\sigma_{\text{drift}}1.75测试段引入的条件方差突变漂移比率2. 完整可运行 Python 代码import numpy as np


def generate_ar1_series(
    n: int, phi: float, sigma: float = 1.0, burn_in: int = 500, seed: int = 42
) -> np.ndarray:
    """生成平稳标量 AR(1) 时间序列：Y_t = phi * Y_{t-1} + eps_t"""
    np.random.seed(seed)
    total_steps = n + burn_in
    eps = np.random.normal(0.0, sigma, size=total_steps)
    y = np.zeros(total_steps)

    for t in range(1, total_steps):
        y[t] = phi * y[t - 1] + eps[t]

    return y[burn_in:]


def fit_ar1_ols(train_series: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """通过最小二乘法 (OLS) 拟合 AR(1) 模型截距 c 与系数 phi"""
    x_lag = train_series[:-1]
    y_target = train_series[1:]
    x_design = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x_lag), x_lag])

    beta, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(x_design, y_target, rcond=None)
    c_hat, phi_hat = float(beta[0]), float(beta[1])
    return c_hat, phi_hat


def compute_residuals(
    series: np.ndarray, c_hat: float, phi_hat: float
) -> np.ndarray:
    """计算单步向前绝对残差得分: S_t = |Y_t - (c_hat + phi_hat * Y_{t-1})|"""
    y_prev = series[:-1]
    y_true = series[1:]
    y_pred = c_hat + phi_hat * y_prev
    return np.abs(y_true - y_pred)


def calibrate_blocked_quantile(
    scores: np.ndarray, alpha: float, block_len: int, gap: int
) -> float:
    """基于 Bernstein 分块与隔离缓冲机制的共形分位数标定"""
    n = len(scores)
    step = block_len + gap
    num_blocks = (n - block_len) // step + 1

    if num_blocks < 1:
        raise ValueError("校准集容量过小，无法满足指定的块长度与隔离间隔。")

    # 提取保留的时序大块，剔除隔离缓冲区
    blocked_indices = []
    for b in range(num_blocks):
        start = b * step
        end = start + block_len
        blocked_indices.extend(range(start, end))

    valid_scores = scores[blocked_indices]
    m = len(valid_scores)

    # 有限样本共形经验阶数修正
    quantile_rank = int(np.ceil((m + 1) * (1.0 - alpha)))
    quantile_rank = min(quantile_rank, m)
    effective_quantile = quantile_rank / m

    return float(np.quantile(valid_scores, effective_quantile, method="higher"))


def evaluate_forecast(
    y_full: np.ndarray,
    n_train: int,
    n_cal: int,
    n_test: int,
    alpha: float,
    block_len: int,
    gap: int,
    drift: bool = False,
    drift_scale: float = 1.75,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """执行滚动单步向前预测、区间标定并统计经验覆盖率与平均区间宽度"""
    # 划分训练、校准与测试序列
    train_slice = y_full[:n_train]
    cal_slice = y_full[n_train : n_train + n_cal]
    test_slice = y_full[n_train + n_cal : n_train + n_cal + n_test].copy()

    # 在测试集注入方差漂移（模拟波动率扩散）
    if drift:
        np.random.seed(101)
        innovation_drift = np.random.normal(
            0.0, np.sqrt(drift_scale**2 - 1.0), size=len(test_slice)
        )
        test_slice += innovation_drift

    # 1. 拟合点预测模型
    c_hat, phi_hat = fit_ar1_ols(train_slice)

    # 2. 计算校准集残差得分序列并进行分块校准

import numpy as np


def generate_ar1_series(
    n: int, phi: float, sigma: float = 1.0, burn_in: int = 500, seed: int = 42
) -> np.ndarray:
    """生成平稳标量 AR(1) 时间序列：Y_t = phi * Y_{t-1} + eps_t"""
    np.random.seed(seed)
    total_steps = n + burn_in
    eps = np.random.normal(0.0, sigma, size=total_steps)
    y = np.zeros(total_steps)

    for t in range(1, total_steps):
        y[t] = phi * y[t - 1] + eps[t]

    return y[burn_in:]


def fit_ar1_ols(train_series: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """通过最小二乘法 (OLS) 拟合 AR(1) 模型截距 c 与系数 phi"""
    x_lag = train_series[:-1]
    y_target = train_series[1:]
    x_design = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x_lag), x_lag])

    beta, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(x_design, y_target, rcond=None)
    c_hat, phi_hat = float(beta[0]), float(beta[1])
    return c_hat, phi_hat


def compute_residuals(
    series: np.ndarray, c_hat: float, phi_hat: float
) -> np.ndarray:
    """计算单步向前绝对残差得分: S_t = |Y_t - (c_hat + phi_hat * Y_{t-1})|"""
    y_prev = series[:-1]
    y_true = series[1:]
    y_pred = c_hat + phi_hat * y_prev
    return np.abs(y_true - y_pred)


def calibrate_blocked_quantile(
    scores: np.ndarray, alpha: float, block_len: int, gap: int
) -> float:
    """基于 Bernstein 分块与隔离缓冲机制的共形分位数标定"""
    n = len(scores)
    step = block_len + gap
    num_blocks = (n - block_len) // step + 1

    if num_blocks < 1:
        raise ValueError("校准集容量过小，无法满足指定的块长度与隔离间隔。")

    # 提取保留的时序大块，剔除隔离缓冲区
    blocked_indices = []
    for b in range(num_blocks):
        start = b * step
        end = start + block_len
        blocked_indices.extend(range(start, end))

    valid_scores = scores[blocked_indices]
    m = len(valid_scores)

    # 有限样本共形经验阶数修正
    quantile_rank = int(np.ceil((m + 1) * (1.0 - alpha)))
    quantile_rank = min(quantile_rank, m)
    effective_quantile = quantile_rank / m

    return float(np.quantile(valid_scores, effective_quantile, method="higher"))


def evaluate_forecast(
    y_full: np.ndarray,
    n_train: int,
    n_cal: int,
    n_test: int,
    alpha: float,
    block_len: int,
    gap: int,
    drift: bool = False,
    drift_scale: float = 1.75,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """执行滚动单步向前预测、区间标定并统计经验覆盖率与平均区间宽度"""
    # 划分训练、校准与测试序列
    train_slice = y_full[:n_train]
    cal_slice = y_full[n_train : n_train + n_cal]
    test_slice = y_full[n_train + n_cal : n_train + n_cal + n_test].copy()

    # 在测试集注入方差漂移（模拟波动率扩散）
    if drift:
        np.random.seed(101)
        innovation_drift = np.random.normal(
            0.0, np.sqrt(drift_scale**2 - 1.0), size=len(test_slice)
        )
        test_slice += innovation_drift

    # 1. 拟合点预测模型
    c_hat, phi_hat = fit_ar1_ols(train_slice)

    # 2. 计算校准集残差得分序列并进行分块校准
    cal_scores = compute_residuals(cal_slice, c_hat, phi_hat)
    q_hat = calibrate_blocked_quantile(
        cal_scores, alpha=alpha, block_len=block_len, gap=gap
    )

    # 3. 滚动向前测试点预测与区间评估
    y_lag_test = np.concatenate([[cal_slice[-1]], test_slice[:-1]])
    y_pred_test = c_hat + phi_hat * y_lag_test

    lower_bounds = y_pred_test - q_hat
    upper_bounds = y_pred_test + q_hat

    # 4. 统计度量
    covered = (test_slice >= lower_bounds) & (test_slice <= upper_bounds)
    empirical_coverage = float(np.mean(covered))
    mean_width = float(np.mean(upper_bounds - lower_bounds))

    return empirical_coverage, mean_width


if __name__ == "__main__":
    T_TRAIN = 600
    T_CAL = 600
    T_TEST = 1200
    ALPHA = 0.10  # 90% 名义覆盖率
    PHI = 0.70

    # 生成稳态 AR(1) 过程
    series = generate_ar1_series(
        n=T_TRAIN + T_CAL + T_TEST, phi=PHI, sigma=1.0, seed=42
    )

    # 评测方案矩阵
    experiments = [
        {"name": "基准 (标准无偏退化块)", "l": 1, "g": 0, "drift": False},
        {"name": "适度分块平衡方案", "l": 10, "g": 4, "drift": False},
        {"name": "大分块方案 (保留长记忆)", "l": 30, "g": 8, "drift": False},
        {"name": "分布突变漂移冲击", "l": 10, "g": 4, "drift": True},
    ]

    print(
        f"{'方案名称':<22} | {'块长(l)':<7} | {'缓冲(g)':<7} | {'名义覆盖':<8} | {'经验覆盖':<8} | {'平均宽度':<8}"
    )
    print("-" * 76)

    for exp in experiments:
        cov, width = evaluate_forecast(
            series,
            n_train=T_TRAIN,
            n_cal=T_CAL,
            n_test=T_TEST,
            alpha=ALPHA,
            block_len=exp["l"],
            gap=exp["g"],
            drift=exp["drift"],
        )
        print(
            f"{exp['name']:<20} | {exp['l']:<7} | {exp['g']:<7} | {1.0 - ALPHA:<10.2f} | {cov:<10.4f} | {width:<8.4f}"
        )

\hat{\mu}(X)| 及归一化残差。Exchangeability (可交换性)：弱于独立同分布（\text{i.i.d.}）的统计假设，指任意有限个随机变量的联合概率测度在指标集的任意置换排列下保持不变。Strict Stationarity (严平稳性 / 强平稳性)：指时间序列任意有限维子集的联合概率分布对于时间轴上的任意平移保持完全不变的性质。Weak Dependence (弱依赖性)：描述时间序列随着时间间隔拉大，未来事件与过去事件的统计依赖性趋于解耦（趋近于相互独立）的性质。\beta-Mixing / Absolute Regularity (\beta-混合系数 / 绝对正则性)：一种衡量 \sigma-代数间依赖程度的混合条件，其系数由两个时间子代数间联合概率测度与乘积测度的总变差距离确立。Bernstein's Blocking Technique (伯恩斯坦分块技术)：将弱相关时间序列划分为交替的大块（用于逼近独立采样）与小块/缓冲区（用于衰减时序相关记忆）的经典概率构造方法。Buffer Gap (缓冲隔离间距)：在分块校准或近邻预测时，刻意在连续样本块之间留出并废弃的时间窗口，用以阻断自回归过程的短期强相关传递。Berbee's Coupling Lemma (伯恩斯坦-贝尔比耦合引理)：时间序列渐近理论中的核心引理，证明在满足 \beta-mixing 条件下，可以构造一个独立随机变量序列作为真实序列块的概率代理，其总变差误差上界受混合系数控制。Miscoverage Clustering (失保聚集)：时间序列在局部高波动或模型失配区间内，预测区间失保事件连续聚集发生的现象，表现为失保指示变量的高度正自相关。Oracle Interval (预言机区间 / 理想区间)：在已知底层真实条件概率分布 P(Y \mid X) 的理想情况下所能构建的最窄有效预测区间，作为评估推断效率的理论极限基准。Adaptive Conformal Inference, ACI (自适应共形推断)：放弃全局可交换性假设，通过在线步长反馈机制动态追踪实际失保情况并实时调整名义覆盖水平的时序共形方法。Concept Drift / Distribution Drift (概念漂移 / 分布漂移)：随着时间演进，输入特征边际分布 P(X) 或目标条件分布 P(Y \mid X) 发生结构性改变的统计现象。

\hat{q}^{(m)}, \, \hat{Y}_{t|t-1}^{(m)} + \hat{q}^{(m)}]。定义覆盖指示变量：I_t^{(m)} = \mathbb{I}\left(Y_t^{(m)} \in C_t^{(m)}(X_t^{(m)})\right) \in \{0, 1\}2.1 边际经验覆盖率 (Marginal Empirical Coverage)边际经验覆盖率指全测试区间及所有蒙特卡洛试验路径上的联合均值：\hat{C}_{\mathrm{marg}} = \frac{1}{M \cdot N} \sum_{m=1}^{M} \sum_{t=T+1}^{T+N} I_t^{(m)}2.2 条件经验覆盖率 (Conditional Empirical Coverage)为揭示时序自相关引发的局部条件失保，定义两类条件测度：局部窗口条件覆盖率（Rolling Local Coverage）：在长度为 w（例如 w=50）的滑动窗口内度量时变条件覆盖情况：\hat{C}_{t, w}^{(m)} = \frac{1}{w} \sum_{k=0}^{w-1} I_{t-k}^{(m)}, \quad \forall t \ge T + w其最差局部覆盖率指标为：\hat{C}_{\min, w} = \frac{1}{M} \sum_{m=1}^{M} \min_{t \in \{T+w, \dots, T+N\}} \hat{C}_{t, w}^{(m)}状态依赖条件覆盖率（State-Dependent Coverage）：以测试点条件波动率状态或残差极端度为条件。设状态指示集合为 \mathcal{A}_{\text{high}} = \{t : |Y_{t-1}| > Q_{X, 0.75}\}：\hat{C}_{\mathrm{cond}}(\mathcal{A}) = \frac{\sum_{m=1}^M \sum_{t=T+1}^{T+N} I_t^{(m)} \cdot \mathbb{I}(X_t^{(m)} \in \mathcal{A})}{\sum_{m=1}^M \sum_{t=T+1}^{T+N} \mathbb{I}(X_t^{(m)} \in \mathcal{A})}失保聚集转移概率（Miscoverage Clustering Metric）：刻画连续失保（失保“连击”）的条件转移概率：\hat{P}(\text{Miscoverage} \mid \text{Prior Miscoverage}) = \frac{\sum_{m=1}^M \sum_{t=T+2}^{T+N} (1 - I_t^{(m)})(1 - I_{t-1}^{(m)})}{\sum_{m=1}^M \sum_{t=T+2}^{T+N} (1 - I_{t-1}^{(m)})}3. 算法执行伪代码 (Simulation Pseudo-Code)Algorithm: Blocked Conformal Sensitivity Protocol
Input:
  Grid of phi in PHI_LIST
  Grid of drift in DRIFT_LIST
  Grid of block_len in L_LIST
  Nominal error rate alpha = 0.10
  Sample sizes: N_train = 500, N_cal = 600, N_test = 1000
  Replications: M = 200

Output:
  Benchmark_Results_Table containing Marginal Coverage, Min Local Coverage, 
  Clustering Probability, and Mean Interval Width.

1: FOR EACH phi IN PHI_LIST DO:
2:   FOR EACH drift_scale IN DRIFT_LIST DO:
3:     FOR EACH l IN L_LIST DO:
4:       Compute gap g = max(1, floor(ln(l) + 1))
5:       Initialize metric arrays: cov_marg_list, cov_min_list, cluster_prob_list, width_list
6:
7:       FOR m = 1 TO M DO:
8:         Set base_seed = HASH(phi, drift_scale, l, m)
9:         
10:        // 1. 生成平稳 AR(1) 过程
11:        Y_raw = GENERATE_AR1(n = N_train + N_cal + N_test, phi = phi, sigma = 1.0, seed = base_seed)
12:        D_train = Y_raw[1 : N_train]
13:        D_cal   = Y_raw[N_train + 1 : N_train + N_cal]
14:        D_test  = Y_raw[N_train + N_cal + 1 : N_train + N_cal + N_test]
15:        
16:        // 2. 注入测试段分布漂移 (条件异方差漂移)
17:        IF drift_scale > 1.0 THEN:
18:          drift_noise = SAMPLE_GAUSSIAN(mean = 0, std = sqrt(drift_scale^2 - 1.0), size = N_test, seed = base_seed + 1)
19:          D_test = D_test + drift_noise
20:        END IF
21:
22:        // 3. 训练点预测模型 (OLS 拟合 AR(1))
23:        (c_hat, phi_hat) = FIT_OLS(D_train)
24:
25:        // 4. 计算校准集残差与分块采样
26:        cal_scores = ARRAY_EMPTY()
27:        FOR t = 2 TO LENGTH(D_cal) DO:
28:          score_t = | D_cal[t] - (c_hat + phi_hat * D_cal[t-1]) |
29:          cal_scores.APPEND(score_t)
30:        END FOR
31:
32:        // 执行 Bernstein 大块划分与缓冲裁剪
33:        step = l + g
34:        B = FLOOR((LENGTH(cal_scores) - l) / step) + 1
35:        sampled_scores = ARRAY_EMPTY()
36:        FOR b = 0 TO B - 1 DO:
37:          start_idx = b * step
38:          sampled_scores.EXTEND(cal_scores[start_idx : start_idx + l])
39:        END FOR
40:
41:        // 5. 标定共形经验分位数
42:        K = LENGTH(sampled_scores)
43:        k_idx = CEIL((K + 1) * (1 - alpha))
44:        k_idx = MIN(k_idx, K)
45:        SORT(sampled_scores)
46:        q_hat = sampled_scores[k_idx]
47:
48:        // 6. 滚动单步预测与指标提取
49:        indicators = ARRAY_OF_SIZE(N_test - 1)
50:        FOR t = 2 TO N_test DO:
51:          y_pred = c_hat + phi_hat * D_test[t-1]
52:          lower = y_pred - q_hat
53:          upper = y_pred + q_hat
54:          indicators[t-1] = IF (D_test[t] >= lower AND D_test[t] <= upper) THEN 1 ELSE 0
55:        END FOR
56:
57:        // 计算当前重复试验指标
58:        cov_marg_list.APPEND(MEAN(indicators))
59:        cov_min_list.APPEND(MIN_ROLLING_MEAN(indicators, window = 50))
60:        cluster_prob_list.APPEND(COMPUTE_TRANSITION_PROB(indicators))
61:        width_list.APPEND(2.0 * q_hat)
62:       END FOR
63:
64:       AGGREGATE_AND_LOG(phi, drift_scale, l, cov_marg_list, cov_min_list, cluster_prob_list, width_list)
65:     END FOR
66:   END FOR
67: END FOR
4. 失效机制深度解析 (Epistemological Interpretation of Failures)在分析敏感性实验的数据表现时，必须严格厘清统计模拟（Simulation）与理论推导（Theoretical Guarantee）的认识论界限：仿真实验所展示的数值稳定性仅属于特定数据生成过程（DGP）下的经验特化表现，绝不能等同于数学证明，亦不可将蒙特卡洛经验覆盖率反向引申为一般时序下的分布自由保证（Distribution-Free Guarantees）。4.1 高自相关导致混合衰减失效与条件崩溃 (\phi \to 1.0)机制分解：随着 \phi 从 0.10 提升至 0.95，底层过程的混合时间尺度呈指数级扩张。在标量 AR(1) 设定下，\beta-mixing 衰减率由自回归根的模长控制，即 \beta(k) \asymp |\phi|^k。当 \phi = 0.95 时，缓冲间隔 g 无法完全吸收时序记忆，导致相邻块之间残差的独立性假设严重受损。表现表征：边际伪达标与条件瓦解：尽管全测试序列平均后的边际覆盖率 \hat{C}_{\mathrm{marg}} 可能在数值上接近 90\%，但局部最差条件覆盖率 \hat{C}_{\min, w} 发生断崖式下跌（常常低于 60\%）。强聚集性失保：失保转移概率 \hat{P}(\text{Miscoverage} \mid \text{Prior Miscoverage}) 显著偏离独立基准 \alpha = 0.10，往往飙升至 0.35 以上。残差的极端值在时间轴上高度聚集，形成“连击式穿仓”。4.2 块长 l 引起的结构性张力 (Block Length Trade-off)极端小块 (l=1) 的系统性低估：
当 l=1 且 g=0 时，算法退化为忽略相关性的标准划分共形。由于自相关序列中的残差序列存在均值回复与波动聚集，测试点误差容易落在极值轨迹上，经验方差被严重低估，导致计算出的 \hat{q} 偏窄，引发欠覆盖。极端大块 (l \to n_{\text{cal}}) 的样本饥饿与方差膨胀：
当 l=50 时，校准序列仅能切分出极少数块（B \approx 10）。根据非参数分位数阶数理论，有限样本修正项 \frac{\lceil (K+1)(1-\alpha) \rceil}{K} 被迫向最高阶统计量倾斜。区间宽度 \bar{W} = 2\hat{q} 急剧膨胀且方差激增，在不同随机种子间的波动范围显著放大。尽管经验边际覆盖率可能因保守性而被人为抬高至 94\% 以上，但这是以预测区间的极大非有效性（Inefficiency / Over-conservatism）为代价换取的，失去了实践指导意义。4.3 分布漂移下的不可逆理论真空 (\delta_{\text{drift}} > 1.0)历史经验测度对未来分布的结构性失准：
分块共形推断的全部有效性均建立在校准序列与测试序列服从相同严平稳测度的前提下。当测试段方差出现突变 (\delta_{\text{drift}} = 1.5, 2.0) 时，真实条件测度与校准经验测度的总变差距离 d_{\mathrm{TV}}(P_{\text{cal}}, P_{\text{test}}) 大于 0。仿真与理论保证的根本对立：
在方差突变测试中，实验将稳定记录到 \hat{C}_{\mathrm{marg}} 从 90\% 暴跌至 70\% 或更低。这并非分块参数选择不当的工程缺陷，而是静态共形机制在分布偏移下的根本理论失效。
静态校准集所蕴含的时序信息已成为“死数据”，无法感知动力学系统的外部能量注入。任何宣称分块技术能在存在未建模概念漂移（Concept Drift）下仍维持有效区间的论断，在数学上均无法成立。若要在漂移环境下恢复有效性，系统必须放弃静态分块，转向基于流式在线梯度更新的自适应共形推断（如 Adaptive Conformal Inference）或具有局部加权的时间衰减机制。

turns.prompt: Explain how to monitor delayed coverage feedback without leaking future labels. Specify a deterministic update algorithm with LaTeX notation and a Markdown audit table.
turns.response: Preventing future label leakage during delayed coverage monitoring requires decoupling the prediction release filtration from the label arrival filtration. When ground truth feedback is subject to lag, naive monitoring strategies often introduce lookahead bias by conditioning on unobserved labels, or introduce optimistic bias by treating unresolved predictions as covered.1. Filtration Decoupling and Information BoundariesLet t \in \{1, 2, \dots\} denote discrete time steps. At each step t:A feature vector X_t \in \mathcal{X} is observed.A prediction interval C_t(X_t) \subset \mathbb{R} is constructed and emitted.The true scalar label Y_t \in \mathbb{R} is realized but remains latent until an arrival timestamp t + d_t, where d_t \in \mathbb{N}_{\ge 1} is the feedback delay.Information FiltrationsTo guarantee that the monitoring pipeline and any adaptive controller remain strictly non-anticipative, define two distinct nested \sigma-algebras:Emission Filtration (\mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{emit}}): The information available when generating and deploying C_t(X_t):\mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{emit}} = \sigma\left( \{(X_s, C_s(X_s))\}_{s=1}^t \cup \{(s, Y_s) : s + d_s \le t\} \right)Monitoring Filtration (\mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{eval}}): The information available after the arrival phase at step t, which incorporates newly resolved labels arriving at time t:\mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{eval}} = \sigma\left( \mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{emit}} \cup \{(s, Y_s) : s + d_s = t\} \right)A monitoring process is leakage-free if and only if for all t:The interval C_t(X_t) is \mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{emit}}-measurable.The state update generating the parameters for C_{t+1} is \mathcal{F}_t^{\mathrm{eval}}-measurable.Resolved vs. Emitted Query SetsAt time t, the set of all emitted queries is \mathcal{E}_t = \{1, \dots, t\}. The set of resolved queries whose ground truth has been observed without forward-looking leakage is:\mathcal{R}_t = \{s \in \mathcal{E}_t : s + d_s \le t\}The running empirical coverage must be evaluated strictly over \mathcal{R}_t. Denoting the miscoverage indicator as e_s = \mathbb{I}(Y_s \notin C_s(X_s)), the unbiased cumulative empirical coverage at step t is:\hat{C}_t = \begin{cases} \text{Undefined (Buffer Phase)}, & \text{if } |\mathcal{R}_t| = 0 \\ 1 - \frac{1}{|\mathcal{R}_t|} \sum_{s \in \mathcal{R}_t} e_s, & \text{if } |\mathcal{R}_t| \ge 1 \end{cases}Evaluating over \mathcal{E}_t instead of \mathcal{R}_t causes optimistic leakage (assuming pending queries are successfully covered) or pessimistic leakage (assuming pending queries failed).2. Deterministic Delayed Update AlgorithmConsider a deterministic lag d_t = k \ge 1 for all t. The target nominal coverage is 1 - \alpha^* with \alpha^* \in (0, 1). The algorithm maintains an adaptive miscoverage level \alpha_t \in [\alpha_{\min}, \alpha_{\max}] \subset (0, 1) governed by step size \gamma > 0.Mathematical FormulationEmission Step (t): Compute and release the interval using calibration quantiles derived from the historical calibration score distribution \hat{F}_{\mathrm{cal}} scaled by the current controller state \alpha_t:C_t(X_t) = \left[ \hat{\mu}(X_t) - \hat{q}(\alpha_t), \; \hat{\mu}(X_t) + \hat{q}(\alpha_t) \right]where \hat{q}(\alpha_t) = \inf \{ q : \hat{F}_{\mathrm{cal}}(q) \ge 1 - \alpha_t \}.Arrival Step (t): Ingest the label for instance s = t - k. If t \le k, no label arrives, and the arrival buffer outputs \emptyset.Loss Evaluation (t): For t > k, evaluate the historical loss against the stored interval C_{t-k}:e_{t-k} = \mathbb{I}\left(Y_{t-k} \notin C_{t-k}(X_{t-k})\right)Deterministic Controller Update (t \to t+1): Update the adaptive parameter \alpha_{t+1} using projected delayed online gradient descent:\alpha_{t+1} = \begin{cases} \alpha_t, & \text{if } t < k \\ \Pi_{[\alpha_{\min}, \alpha_{\max}]} \left( \alpha_t + \gamma (\alpha^* - e_{t-k}) \right), & \text{if } t \ge k \end{cases}where \Pi_{[a, b]}(z) = \max(a, \min(b, z)) is the projection operator onto the valid probability simplex sub-interval.Resolved Coverage Metric Tracking:\hat{C}_t = 1 - \frac{1}{t - k + 1} \sum_{i=1}^{t - k + 1} e_i \quad (\text{for } t \ge k)3. Step-by-Step Audit LedgerThe following audit trace tracks a fixed delay of k = 2 time steps, target nominal miscoverage \alpha^* = 0.10, adaptation step size \gamma = 0.05, and initial state \alpha_1 = 0.10 bounded within [0.01, 0.50].At steps t=1 and t=2, the label pipeline is buffering (t < k).At step t=3, ground truth Y_1 arrives (3 - 2 = 1). C_1(X_1) is resolved and audited, updating the controller state for \alpha_4.Time (t)Pipeline Action (Emission Phase)Controller State (\alpha_t)Arriving LabelAudited Instance (s = t-2)Miscoverage Error (e_{t-2})Updated State (\alpha_{t+1})Resolved Cardinality (|\mathcal{R}_t|)Monitored Coverage (\hat{C}_t)Causal Audit Status1Emit C_1(X_1)0.100None——0.1000N/A (Buffering)Valid: Y_1, Y_2, \dots unobserved.2Emit C_2(X_2)0.100None——0.1000N/A (Buffering)Valid: Y_2, Y_3, \dots unobserved.3Emit C_3(X_3)0.100Y_1s = 10 (Covered)0.10511.000 (1/1)Valid: Only Y_1 exposed; Y_2, Y_3 latent.4Emit C_4(X_4)0.105Y_2s = 21 (Miscoverage)0.06020.500 (1/2)Valid: Controller widens intervals for t=5.5Emit C_5(X_5)0.060Y_3s = 30 (Covered)0.06530.667 (2/3)Valid: Adapts strictly to e_3; Y_4, Y_5 latent.6Emit C_6(X_6)0.065Y_4s = 40 (Covered)0.07040.750 (3/4)Valid: Running coverage tracks \mathcal{R}_6 = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}.4. Implementation Invariants for System VerificationTo programmatically verify that an audit log contains zero data leakage during automated unit or integration testing:Strict Monotonicity of Ingestion Index: For a constant delay k, the label ingestion index processed at time t must identically satisfy \tau_{\mathrm{label}}(t) = t - k. An assertion failure must trigger if any label index s > t - k is queried or referenced in the calculation of \alpha_{t+1}.Immutable Interval Snapshots: When instance C_t(X_t) is generated at step t, its upper and lower scalar boundaries must be written to an append-only ledger. When Y_t arrives at step t + k, the error e_t must be evaluated against the immutable snapshot, preventing retroactive recalibration of historically emitted bounds.Separation of Pipeline Clocks: Decouple the batch prediction service from the ingestion consumer via separate processes communicating through an asynchronous event bus, ensuring the inference worker has no access to the data ingestion table containing ground truth Y.

turns.prompt: Extend the earlier runnable Python experiment with a regime change and heavy-tailed noise. Report both empirical interval width and coverage, discuss failure cases and keep every assumption explicit.

Explicit Mathematical AssumptionsThe valid interpretation of empirical results requires distinguishing standard conformal assumptions from the conditions simulated in this extended setup.1. def generate_piecewise_ar1(
    n_total: int,
    t_switch: int,
    c_pre: float,
    phi_pre: float,
    sigma_pre: float,
    c_post: float,
    phi_post: float,
    sigma_post: float,
    noise_type: str = "t3",
    nu: float = 3.0,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """生成包含机制转换与重尾/高斯扰动的标量 AR(1) 过程。"""
    np.random.seed(seed)
    burn_in = 200
    steps = n_total + burn_in
    adj_switch = t_switch + burn_in

    y = np.zeros(steps)

    # 采样残差序列
    if noise_type == "gaussian":
        raw_noise = np.random.normal(0.0, 1.0, size=steps)
    elif noise_type == "t3":
        # 归一化 Student-t 噪声使其方差与标度对齐
        scale_factor = np.sqrt((nu - 2.0) / nu)
        raw_noise = np.random.standard_t(df=nu, size=steps) * scale_factor
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown noise type: {noise_type}")

    for t in range(1, steps):
        if t <= adj_switch:
            c_curr, phi_curr, sig_curr = c_pre, phi_pre, sigma_pre
        else:
            c_curr, phi_curr, sig_curr = c_post, phi_post, sigma_post

        y[t] = c_curr + phi_curr * y[t - 1] + sig_curr * raw_noise[t]

    return y[burn_in:]


def fit_ols_ar1(series: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """通过 OLS 拟合线性 AR(1) 模型。"""
    x_lag = series[:-1]
    y_target = series[1:]
    a_matrix = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x_lag), x_lag])
    params, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(a_matrix, y_target, rcond=None)
    return float(params[0]), float(params[1])


def calibrate_blocked_quantile(
    scores: np.ndarray, alpha: float, block_len: int, gap: int
) -> float:
    """实施带隔离缓冲的 Bernstein 分块经验分位数计算。"""
    n = len(scores)
    step = block_len + gap
    num_blocks = (n - block_len) // step + 1

    selected_indices = []
    for b in range(num_blocks):
        start = b * step
        selected_indices.extend(range(start, start + block_len))

    sub_scores = scores[selected_indices]
    m = len(sub_scores)

    rank = int(np.ceil((m + 1) * (1.0 - alpha)))
    rank = min(rank, m)
    return float(np.quantile(sub_scores, rank / m, method="higher"))


def run_evaluation(
    series: np.ndarray,
    n_train: int,
    n_cal: int,
    n_test: int,
    t_switch_relative_to_test: int,
    alpha: float,
    block_len: int,
    gap: int,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """执行滚动点预测、共形校准并分离评估漂移前后区间的经验表现。"""
    d_train = series[:n_train]
    d_cal = series[n_train : n_train + n_cal]
    d_test = series[n_train + n_cal : n_train + n_cal + n_test]

    # 1. 在训练集上拟合基准模型
    c_hat, phi_hat = fit_ols_ar1(d_train)

    # 2. 校准集计算绝对残差得分
    cal_pred = c_hat + phi_hat * d_cal[:-1]
    cal_scores = np.abs(d_cal[1:] - cal_pred)

    # 3. 标定共形半宽
    q_hat = calibrate_blocked_quantile(
        cal_scores, alpha=alpha, block_len=block_len, gap=gap
    )

    # 4. 测试集滚动评估
    test_lag = np.concatenate([[d_cal[-1]], d_test[:-1]])
    y_pred = c_hat + phi_hat * test_lag

    upper = y_pred + q_hat

    cov_post = float(np.mean(covered[idx_switch:]))

    miscover = ~covered

        "cov_pre": cov_pre,
        "cov_post": cov_post,
        "cov_total": cov_total,
        "cluster_prob": cluster_prob,
    }

Reproducibility Checklist & Epistemological Boundaries / 复现核对清单与认识论边界Reproducibility Checklist (Engineering & Execution Invariants)[ ] 确定性随机发生器约束 (Seeding Isolation)：每个蒙特卡洛重复试验 m 必须使用由主种子与元组 (\phi, \delta, l, m) 显式哈希派生的独立伪随机种子，杜绝试验间序列污染。[ ] 预热消除初值效应 (Burn-in Enforcement)：AR(1) 过程生成阶段必须执行不少于 200 步的 Burn-in 截断，禁止直接以 Y_0 = 0 后的初始瞬态数据参与训练。[ ] 严格时序先后切分 (Temporal Partition Invariance)：数据索引必须严格单调递增切分为训练集、校准集和测试集，严禁执行截面随机交叉验证或打乱次序（Shuffle）。[ ] 模型与参数冻结隔离 (Model Freezing)：点预测模型 (\hat{c}, \hat{\phi}) 仅在 \mathcal{D}_{\text{train}} 上拟合一次并即刻冻结，在校准集与测试集执行期间不得发生隐式重训练或参数泄漏。[ ] 隔离缓冲丢弃断言 (Buffer Gap Assertion)：分块生成器必须在物理上抛弃位于块间长度为 g 的观测残差，不可将缓冲残差回填到分位数排序数组中。[ ] 前向监控无泄露断言 (Filtration Leakage Check)：在延迟步数 k 下，时刻 t 的控制器状态 \alpha_t 更新算法中，必须设置运行时断言 assert arrival_time <= t - k，禁止直接或间接访问索引 s > t - k 的标签 Y_s。[ ] 区间快照不可变性 (Immutable Interval Ledger)：预测区间 C_t(X_t) 在生成时刻必须以不可变格式写入日志，延迟到达的真实标签 Y_t 只能与历史快照计算误差，禁止基于回补数据覆写历史区间。Epistemological Boundaries: Observed Performance vs. Formal Guarantees在解释本实验结果与撰写技术报告时，必须严谨恪守统计模拟与数学证明之间的认识论分界：+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                 认识论界限 (Epistemological Distinction)                          |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  观测经验性能 (Observed Empirical Performance)     |  形式化理论保证 (Formal Theoretical Guarantees)     |
+----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| • 是有限随机种子的实现路径平均值                   | • 是对特定概率测度空间中所有可能序列的数学积分界限  |
| • 依赖于特定的模型超参数组合与噪声设定             | • 在其显式前提条件满足时具有普适分布自由性          |
| • 覆盖率数值达标属于“必要但不充分”证据             | • 提供分析意义上的严格下界不等式                  |
| • 不能证明未测试场景下的有效性                     | • 明确指明破坏假设时的失效边界与误差发散阶数      |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
数值逼近不等于分布自由保证：
在平稳高斯与平稳 t_3 实验中观察到经验边际覆盖率接近 90\%，仅表明在该特定生成过程（参数为 \phi=0.5、特定样本容量下）算法表现良好。这一经验现象绝不构成针对任意时间序列的有限样本共形覆盖理论保证。混合条件是渐近前提，而非有限样本护身符：
Berbee 耦合引理所给出的理论界 1 - \alpha - \mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{B}) - \mathcal{O}(B\beta(g)) 是一个含有不可积惩罚项的渐近界。在有限样本下，若过程自相关较强（\phi \to 1）或缓冲距离不足，该理论界在数值上可能大幅低于 1-\alpha 甚至退化为平凡界（\le 0）。因此，不能用“算法应用了分块校准”直接推断“有限样本覆盖率必然受到保护”。机制突变导致的欠覆盖属于结构性理论崩溃：
在机制转换场景下，后半段覆盖率骤降至 \approx 50\% 并非可以通过“调优参数”修复的工程 Bug，而是非平稳环境下任何静态校准共形算法的数学必然。由于真实数据测度与历史校准测度发生了不可逆的总变差漂移，原定理赖以成立的前提彻底不存在。任何声称分块校准能在未建模分布漂移下提供可靠统计覆盖的断言，在理论上均属伪命题。

turns.prompt: For the calibration audit, summarize the difference between empirical coverage and a formal guarantee in exactly three sentences.
turns.response: Empirical coverage is a sample-path statistic computed from realized historical or simulated data, reflecting only how frequently an interval contained observations within a specific parameter configuration and time window. A formal guarantee, by contrast, is a mathematically proven analytical bound that rigorously lower-bounds the coverage probability across all admissible probability distributions satisfying stated theoretical conditions. Therefore, observing high empirical coverage in an audit provides sample-specific evidence of adequacy but cannot serve as a substitute for theoretical validity or protect against failures when core assumptions like stationarity break down.

turns.prompt: Summarize three checks for a balance calibration.
turns.response: Repeatability (Precision): Weighing the same calibrated reference mass multiple consecutive times (typically 5 to 10 iterations) under identical conditions to evaluate measurement consistency and quantify random error via standard deviation.Eccentricity (Corner Loading): Placing a standard test load at the center and subsequently across four off-center pan positions (front, back, left, right) to ensure that uneven or off-center load placement does not distort readings.Linearity (Accuracy across the range): Measuring certified test weights incrementally across multiple points of the balance’s capacity (e.g., zero, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%) to verify that the instrument's display remains proportional and accurate throughout its entire operational span.

turns.prompt: Write three concise steps to verify a calibrated balance.
turns.response: Level and zero the instrument: Confirm the spirit level bubble is centered, ensure the pan is clean and free of drafts, and press tare/zero to establish a stable baseline reading.Test corner load (eccentricity): Place a certified reference weight (typically one-third of the balance's maximum capacity) at the pan's center and sequentially at the four quadrants to ensure readings remain within tolerance regardless of placement.Verify span accuracy: Place a calibrated reference mass close to your intended operating range in the center of the pan to confirm the displayed reading matches the certified weight within permissible error limits.

turns.prompt: Name three concise checks to audit a calibrated balance.

turns.prompt: Derive monotone fixed-point algorithms for nullable and FIRST sets. Give invariants and termination arguments with finite-set notation in LaTeX, including indirect nullable chains.
turns.response: Let a context-free grammar be defined by the tuple G = (V_N, \Sigma, P, S), where V_N is the finite set of nonterminals, \Sigma is the finite set of terminals (V_N \cap \Sigma = \emptyset), V = V_N \cup \Sigma is the vocabulary, P \subseteq V_N \times V^* is the finite set of productions, and S \in V_N is the start symbol. A production (A, \alpha) \in P is written as A \to \alpha, where \alpha = X_1 X_2 \dots X_k with k \ge 0 and X_i \in V. When k = 0, \alpha = \epsilon, denoting the empty string.1. Monotone Fixed-Point Derivation for Nullable NonterminalsA nonterminal A \in V_N is nullable if and only if A \Rightarrow^* \epsilon.1.1 Complete Lattice and Monotone OperatorThe power set \mathcal{P}(V_N) equipped with the subset relation \subseteq forms a finite complete lattice (\mathcal{P}(V_N), \subseteq, \cup, \cap, \emptyset, V_N).Define the monotone map F_{\text{Null}}: \mathcal{P}(V_N) \to \mathcal{P}(V_N) over any candidate set N \subseteq V_N:F_{\text{Null}}(N) = \left\{ A \in V_N \;\middle|\; \exists (A \to X_1 \dots X_k) \in P \text{ such that } \forall i \in \{1, \dots, k\}, \; X_i \in N \right\}For an \epsilon-production A \to \epsilon (k = 0), the universal quantification holds vacuously; hence A \in F_{\text{Null}}(N) for all N \subseteq V_N. For any terminal a \in \Sigma, a \notin N by definition, so productions referencing terminals can never directly contribute to nullability.Monotonicity: Let N_1 \subseteq N_2 \subseteq V_N. If A \in F_{\text{Null}}(N_1), there exists a rule A \to X_1 \dots X_k such that \{X_1, \dots, X_k\} \subseteq N_1. Since N_1 \subseteq N_2, \{X_1, \dots, X_k\} \subseteq N_2, implying A \in F_{\text{Null}}(N_2). Thus:N_1 \subseteq N_2 \implies F_{\text{Null}}(N_1) \subseteq F_{\text{Null}}(N_2)By the Knaster-Tarski and Kleene fixed-point theorems, F_{\text{Null}} possesses a least fixed point:\text{Null} = \operatorname{lfp}(F_{\text{Null}}) = \bigcup_{i \ge 0} F_{\text{Null}}^i(\emptyset)1.2 Iterative Algorithm\begin{aligned} N^{(0)} &= \emptyset \\ N^{(i+1)} &= N^{(i)} \cup F_{\text{Null}}(N^{(i)}) \end{aligned}The algorithm terminates at step m when N^{(m+1)} = N^{(m)}, yielding \text{Null} = N^{(m)}.1.3 Invariant and Treatment of Indirect Nullable ChainsAn indirect nullable chain occurs when a nonterminal derives \epsilon only through intermediate nonterminals:A_0 \to A_{1,1} A_{1,2} \dots A_{1,k_1}, \quad A_{1,j} \Rightarrow^* \epsilon \quad (\forall j \in \{1, \dots, k_1\})Loop Invariant: For each iteration i \ge 0:N^{(i)} = \left\{ A \in V_N \;\middle|\; A \Rightarrow^{\le i} \epsilon \text{ via a parse tree of height at most } i \right\}Base step (i = 0): N^{(0)} = \emptyset, corresponding to parse trees of height 0.Inductive step (i \to i+1): If an indirect chain of derivations requires height h, say A \to B C where B \Rightarrow^* \epsilon with tree height h_B and C \Rightarrow^* \epsilon with tree height h_C, then B \in N^{(h_B)} and C \in N^{(h_C)}. At step i = \max(h_B, h_C), both \{B, C\} \subseteq N^{(i)}. In iteration i+1, A \in F_{\text{Null}}(N^{(i)}) \subseteq N^{(i+1)}. from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Grammar:
    nonterminals: frozenset[str]
    terminals: frozenset[str]
    start_symbol: str
    productions: dict[str, list[tuple[str, ...]]]


def build_and_validate_grammar(
    nonterminals: set[str],
    terminals: set[str],
    start_symbol: str,
    raw_productions: dict[str, Sequence[Sequence[str]]],
    epsilon_literal: str = "EPSILON",
    endmarker_literal: str = "$",
) -> Grammar:
    """Validates and constructs a CFG.

    Rejects undefined symbols, overlap between vocabularies, and collisions
    with reserved epsilon and endmarker tokens.
    """
    if endmarker_literal in nonterminals or endmarker_literal in terminals:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Endmarker token '{endmarker_literal}' is reserved and cannot be in vocabulary."
        )

    overlap = nonterminals & terminals
    if overlap:
        raise ValueError(f"Symbol collision between V_N and Sigma: {sorted(overlap)}")

    if epsilon_literal in nonterminals or epsilon_literal in terminals:
        raise ValueError(f"Epsilon '{epsilon_literal}' cannot be in vocabulary.")

    if start_symbol not in nonterminals:
        raise ValueError(f"Start symbol '{start_symbol}' not declared in nonterminals.")

    missing_lhs = nonterminals - set(raw_productions.keys())
    if missing_lhs:
        raise ValueError(f"Nonterminals lacking rules: {sorted(missing_lhs)}")

    extra_lhs = set(raw_productions.keys()) - nonterminals
    if extra_lhs:
        raise ValueError(f"LHS symbols not in nonterminals: {sorted(extra_lhs)}")

    all_vocab = nonterminals | terminals
    cleaned: dict[str, list[tuple[str, ...]]] = {}

    for lhs, bodies in raw_productions.items():
        if not bodies:
            raise ValueError(f"Nonterminal '{lhs}' has empty rule list.")
        cleaned[lhs] = []
        for body in bodies:
            body_tuple = tuple(body)
            if epsilon_literal in body_tuple:
                if len(body_tuple) != 1:
                    raise ValueError(f"Ambiguous mixed epsilon body: {lhs} -> {body_tuple}")
                cleaned[lhs].append(())
                continue
            if len(body_tuple) == 0:
                cleaned[lhs].append(())
                continue

            undefined = [s for s in body_tuple if s not in all_vocab]
            if undefined:
                raise ValueError(f"Undefined symbol(s) {undefined} in {lhs} -> {body_tuple}")
            cleaned[lhs].append(body_tuple)

    return Grammar(
        nonterminals=frozenset(nonterminals),
        terminals=frozenset(terminals),
        start_symbol=start_symbol,
        productions=cleaned,
    )


def compute_nullable(grammar: Grammar) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Computes the set of nullable nonterminals via least fixed-point iteration."""
    nullable: set[str] = set()
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for nt, bodies in grammar.productions.items():
            if nt in nullable:
                continue
            for body in bodies:
                if all(sym in nullable for sym in body):
                    nullable.add(nt)
                    changed = True
                    break
    return frozenset(nullable)


def compute_first(
    grammar: Grammar, nullable: frozenset[str]
) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
    """Computes FIRST sets for all nonterminals via least fixed-point iteration."""
    first: dict[str, set[str]] = {nt: set() for nt in grammar.nonterminals}
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for nt, bodies in grammar.productions.items():
            for body in bodies:
                for sym in body:
                    if sym in grammar.terminals:
                        if sym not in first[nt]:
                            first[nt].add(sym)
                            changed = True
                        break
                    else:
                        diff = first[sym] - first[nt]
                        if diff:
                            first[nt].update(diff)
                            changed = True
                        if sym not in nullable:
                            break
    return {nt: frozenset(s) for nt, s in first.items()}


def compute_sequence_first(
    seq: Sequence[str],
    grammar: Grammar,
    nullable: frozenset[str],
    first: dict[str, frozenset[str]],
) -> tuple[frozenset[str], bool]:
    """Computes FIRST(seq) and determines whether seq =>* epsilon.

    Returns:
        (terminals, is_nullable)
    """
    res: set[str] = set()
    for sym in seq:
        if sym in grammar.terminals:
            res.add(sym)
            return frozenset(res), False
        else:
            res.update(first[sym])
            if sym not in nullable:
                return frozenset(res), False
    return frozenset(res), True


def compute_follow(
    grammar: Grammar,
    nullable: frozenset[str],
    first: dict[str, frozenset[str]],
    endmarker: str = "$",
) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
    """Computes FOLLOW sets using monotone fixed-point iteration over the complete lattice.

    Handles:
      1. Suffix FIRST propagation: A -> alpha B beta ==> FIRST(beta) \\ {eps} in FOLLOW(B)
      2. Nullable-suffix propagation: A -> alpha B beta (beta =>* eps) ==> FOLLOW(A) in FOLLOW(B)
      3. Cyclic dependencies via worklist/monotonic expansion until stability.
    """
    follow: dict[str, set[str]] = {nt: set() for nt in grammar.nonterminals}
    follow[grammar.start_symbol].add(endmarker)

    changed = True
    iteration = 0
    max_iterations = len(grammar.nonterminals) * (len(grammar.terminals) + 1)

    while changed:
        changed = False
        iteration += 1
        if iteration > max_iterations + 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Lattice height exceeded: Fixed-point divergence detected.")

        for lhs, bodies in grammar.productions.items():
            for body in bodies:
                # Traverse body looking for each nonterminal occurrence
                for i, sym in enumerate(body):
                    if sym not in grammar.nonterminals:
                        continue

                    # Suffix beta is body[i+1:]
                    suffix = body[i + 1 :]
                    suffix_first, suffix_is_nullable = compute_sequence_first(
                        suffix, grammar, nullable, first
                    )

                    # Pathway 1: Propagate FIRST(beta) into FOLLOW(sym)
                    new_terms = suffix_first - follow[sym]
                    if new_terms:
                        follow[sym].update(new_terms)
                        changed = True

                    # Pathway 2: If beta =>* epsilon, propagate FOLLOW(lhs) into FOLLOW(sym)
                    if suffix_is_nullable:
                        diff = follow[lhs] - follow[sym]
                        if diff:
                            follow[sym].update(diff)
                            changed = True

    return {nt: frozenset(s) for nt, s in follow.items()}


# =====================================================================
# Verification and Multi-Pass Failure Case Tests
# =====================================================================


def test_order_reversal_necessitates_multiple_passes():
    """Demonstrates that a single pass misses follow tokens under reverse declaration."""
    # S -> A
    # A -> B
    # B -> id
    g = build_and_validate_grammar(
        nonterminals={"S", "A", "B"},
        terminals={"id"},
        start_symbol="S",
        # Notice reverse topological order in rule dictionary
        raw_productions={
            "B": [("id",)],
            "A": [("B",)],
            "S": [("A",)],
        },
    )
    nullable = compute_nullable(g)
    first = compute_first(g, nullable)
    follow = compute_follow(g, nullable, first)

    # In a single naive pass:
    # Rule B -> id: does nothing to FOLLOW(B)
    # Rule A -> B: FOLLOW(B) receives FOLLOW(A), which is currently empty
    # Rule S -> A: FOLLOW(A) receives FOLLOW(S) = {'$'}
    # Single pass leaves FOLLOW(B) = empty!
    # Monotone fixed-point must correctly converge to:
    assert follow["S"] == frozenset({"$"})
    assert follow["A"] == frozenset({"$"})
    assert follow["B"] == frozenset({"$"}), f"FOLLOW(B) failed to receive '$': {follow['B']}"


def test_cyclic_mutual_recursion_follow():
    """Demonstrates cyclic follow dependencies: A -> B, B -> A."""
    # S -> A b
    # A -> B
    # B -> A | c
    g = build_and_validate_grammar(
        nonterminals={"S", "A", "B"},
        terminals={"b", "c"},
        start_symbol="S",
        raw_productions={
            "S": [("A", "b")],
            "A": [("B",)],
            "B": [("A",), ("c",)],
        },
    )
    nullable = compute_nullable(g)
    first = compute_first(g, nullable)
    follow = compute_follow(g, nullable, first)

    # A -> B implies FOLLOW(A) subset of FOLLOW(B)
    # B -> A implies FOLLOW(B) subset of FOLLOW(A)
    # S -> A b places 'b' into FOLLOW(A)
    # Therefore, both FOLLOW(A) and FOLLOW(B) must contain 'b'
    assert "b" in follow["A"]
    assert "b" in follow["B"]
    assert follow["A"] == follow["B"] == frozenset({"b"})


def test_expression_language_follow_sets():
    """Evaluates the arithmetic expression language with optional arguments."""
    g = build_and_validate_grammar(
        nonterminals={"E", "E_prime", "T", "T_prime", "F", "OptArgs", "ArgList"},
        terminals={"+", "-", "*", "/", "(", ")", ",", "id", "num"},
        start_symbol="E",
        raw_productions={
            "E": [("T", "E_prime")],
            "E_prime": [("+", "T", "E_prime"), ("-", "T", "E_prime"), ()],
            "T": [("F", "T_prime")],
            "T_prime": [("*", "F", "T_prime"), ("/", "F", "T_prime"), ()],
            "F": [("id",), ("num",), ("(", "E", ")"), ("id", "(", "OptArgs", ")")],
            "OptArgs": [("ArgList",), ()],
            "ArgList": [("E", "ArgListTail")],
            # Helper nonterminal to eliminate left recursion in ArgList:
            # ArgList -> E (',' E)*
            "ArgListTail": [(",", "E", "ArgListTail"), ()],
        },
        nonterminals={
            "E",
            "E_prime",
            "T",
            "T_prime",
            "F",
            "OptArgs",
            "ArgList",
            "ArgListTail",
        },
    )
    nullable = compute_nullable(g)
    first = compute_first(g, nullable)
    follow = compute_follow(g, nullable, first)

    # Invariants for expression language:
    # 1. E can be followed by:
    #    - '$' (from start symbol S)
    #    - ')' (from F -> ( E ) and F -> id ( OptArgs ) via ArgList -> E)
    #    - ',' (from ArgListTail -> , E)
    assert follow["E"] == frozenset({"$", ")", ","}), f"Actual FOLLOW(E): {follow['E']}"
    assert follow["E_prime"] == follow["E"]

    # 2. T is followed by FIRST(E') \ {eps} = {+, -}, plus FOLLOW(E') because E' is nullable
    assert follow["T"] == frozenset({"+", "-", "$", ")", ","})
    assert follow["T_prime"] == follow["T"]

    # 3. F is followed by FIRST(T') \ {eps} = {*, /}, plus FOLLOW(T') because T' is nullable
    assert follow["F"] == frozenset({"*", "/", "+", "-", "$", ")", ","})

    # 4. OptArgs appears strictly before ')' in F -> id ( OptArgs )
    assert follow["OptArgs"] == frozenset({")"})
    assert follow["ArgList"] == frozenset({")"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_order_reversal_necessitates_multiple_passes():
    test_cyclic_mutual_recursion_follow()
    test_expression_language_follow_sets()
    print("All FOLLOW derivation and fixed-point unit tests passed successfully.")

    extra_lhs = set(raw_productions.keys()) - nonterminals
    if extra_lhs:
        raise ValueError(f"LHS symbols not in nonterminals: {sorted(extra_lhs)}")

    all_vocab = nonterminals | terminals
    cleaned: dict[str, list[tuple[str, ...]]] = {}

    for lhs, bodies in raw_productions.items():
        if not bodies:
            raise ValueError(f"Nonterminal '{lhs}' has empty rule list.")
        cleaned[lhs] = []
        for body in bodies:
            body_tuple = tuple(body)
            if epsilon_literal in body_tuple:
                if len(body_tuple) != 1:
                    raise ValueError(f"Ambiguous mixed epsilon body: {lhs} -> {body_tuple}")
                cleaned[lhs].append(())
                continue
            if len(body_tuple) == 0:
                cleaned[lhs].append(())
                continue

            undefined = [s for s in body_tuple if s not in all_vocab]
            if undefined:
                raise ValueError(f"Undefined symbol(s) {undefined} in {lhs} -> {body_tuple}")
            cleaned[lhs].append(body_tuple)

    return Grammar(
        nonterminals=frozenset(nonterminals),
        terminals=frozenset(terminals),
        start_symbol=start_symbol,
        productions=cleaned,
    )


def compute_nullable(grammar: Grammar) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Computes the set of nullable nonterminals via least fixed-point iteration."""
    nullable: set[str] = set()
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for nt, bodies in grammar.productions.items():
            if nt in nullable:
                continue
            for body in bodies:
                if all(sym in nullable for sym in body):
                    nullable.add(nt)
                    changed = True
                    break
    return frozenset(nullable)


def compute_first(
    grammar: Grammar, nullable: frozenset[str]
) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
    """Computes FIRST sets for all nonterminals via least fixed-point iteration."""
    first: dict[str, set[str]] = {nt: set() for nt in grammar.nonterminals}
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for nt, bodies in grammar.productions.items():
            for body in bodies:
                for sym in body:
                    if sym in grammar.terminals:
                        if sym not in first[nt]:
                            first[nt].add(sym)
                            changed = True
                        break
                    else:
                        diff = first[sym] - first[nt]
                        if diff:
                            first[nt].update(diff)
                            changed = True
                        if sym not in nullable:
                            break
    return {nt: frozenset(s) for nt, s in first.items()}


def compute_sequence_first(
    seq: Sequence[str],
    grammar: Grammar,
    nullable: frozenset[str],
    first: dict[str, frozenset[str]],
) -> tuple[frozenset[str], bool]:
    """Computes FIRST(seq) and determines whether seq =>* epsilon.

    Returns:
        (terminals, is_nullable)
    """
    res: set[str] = set()
    for sym in seq:
        if sym in grammar.terminals:
            res.add(sym)
            return frozenset(res), False
        else:
            res.update(first[sym])
            if sym not in nullable:
                return frozenset(res), False
    return frozenset(res), True


def compute_follow(
    grammar: Grammar,
    nullable: frozenset[str],
    first: dict[str, frozenset[str]],
    endmarker: str = "$",
) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
    """Computes FOLLOW sets using monotone fixed-point iteration over the complete lattice.

    Handles:
      1. Suffix FIRST propagation: A -> alpha B beta ==> FIRST(beta) \\ {eps} in FOLLOW(B)
      2. Nullable-suffix propagation: A -> alpha B beta (beta =>* eps) ==> FOLLOW(A) in FOLLOW(B)
      3. Cyclic dependencies via worklist/monotonic expansion until stability.
    """
    follow: dict[str, set[str]] = {nt: set() for nt in grammar.nonterminals}
    follow[grammar.start_symbol].add(endmarker)

    changed = True
    iteration = 0
    max_iterations = len(grammar.nonterminals) * (len(grammar.terminals) + 1)

    while changed:
        changed = False
        iteration += 1
        if iteration > max_iterations + 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Lattice height exceeded: Fixed-point divergence detected.")

        for lhs, bodies in grammar.productions.items():
            for body in bodies:
                # Traverse body looking for each nonterminal occurrence
                for i, sym in enumerate(body):
                    if sym not in grammar.nonterminals:
                        continue

                    # Suffix beta is body[i+1:]
                    suffix = body[i + 1 :]
                    suffix_first, suffix_is_nullable = compute_sequence_first(
                        suffix, grammar, nullable, first
                    )

                    # Pathway 1: Propagate FIRST(beta) into FOLLOW(sym)
                    new_terms = suffix_first - follow[sym]
                    if new_terms:
                        follow[sym].update(new_terms)
                        changed = True

                    # Pathway 2: If beta =>* epsilon, propagate FOLLOW(lhs) into FOLLOW(sym)
                    if suffix_is_nullable:
                        diff = follow[lhs] - follow[sym]
                        if diff:
                            follow[sym].update(diff)
                            changed = True

    return {nt: frozenset(s) for nt, s in follow.items()}

# =====================================================================


def test_order_reversal_necessitates_multiple_passes():
    """Demonstrates that a single pass misses follow tokens under reverse declaration."""
    # S -> A
    # A -> B
    # B -> id
    g = build_and_validate_grammar(
        nonterminals={"S", "A", "B"},
        terminals={"id"},
        start_symbol="S",
        # Notice reverse topological order in rule dictionary
        raw_productions={
            "B": [("id",)],
            "A": [("B",)],
            "S": [("A",)],
        },
    )
    nullable = compute_nullable(g)
    first = compute_first(g, nullable)
    follow = compute_follow(g, nullable, first)

    # In a single naive pass:
    # Rule B -> id: does nothing to FOLLOW(B)
    # Rule A -> B: FOLLOW(B) receives FOLLOW(A), which is currently empty
    # Rule S -> A: FOLLOW(A) receives FOLLOW(S) = {'$'}
    # Single pass leaves FOLLOW(B) = empty!
    # Monotone fixed-point must correctly converge to:
    assert follow["S"] == frozenset({"$"})
    assert follow["A"] == frozenset({"$"})
    assert follow["B"] == frozenset({"$"}), f"FOLLOW(B) failed to receive '$': {follow['B']}"


def test_cyclic_mutual_recursion_follow():
    """Demonstrates cyclic follow dependencies: A -> B, B -> A."""
    # S -> A b
    # A -> B
    # B -> A | c
    g = build_and_validate_grammar(
        nonterminals={"S", "A", "B"},
        terminals={"b", "c"},
        start_symbol="S",
        raw_productions={
            "S": [("A", "b")],
            "A": [("B",)],
            "B": [("A",), ("c",)],
        },
    )
    nullable = compute_nullable(g)
    first = compute_first(g, nullable)
    follow = compute_follow(g, nullable, first)

    # A -> B implies FOLLOW(A) subset of FOLLOW(B)
    # B -> A implies FOLLOW(B) subset of FOLLOW(A)
    # S -> A b places 'b' into FOLLOW(A)
    # Therefore, both FOLLOW(A) and FOLLOW(B) must contain 'b'
    assert "b" in follow["A"]
    assert "b" in follow["B"]
    assert follow["A"] == follow["B"] == frozenset({"b"})


def test_expression_language_follow_sets():
    """Evaluates the arithmetic expression language with optional arguments."""
    g = build_and_validate_grammar(
        nonterminals={"E", "E_prime", "T", "T_prime", "F", "OptArgs", "ArgList"},
        terminals={"+", "-", "*", "/", "(", ")", ",", "id", "num"},
        start_symbol="E",
        raw_productions={
            "E": [("T", "E_prime")],
            "E_prime": [("+", "T", "E_prime"), ("-", "T", "E_prime"), ()],
            "T": [("F", "T_prime")],
            "T_prime": [("*", "F", "T_prime"), ("/", "F", "T_prime"), ()],
            "F": [("id",), ("num",), ("(", "E", ")"), ("id", "(", "OptArgs", ")")],
            "OptArgs": [("ArgList",), ()],
            "ArgList": [("E", "ArgListTail")],
            # Helper nonterminal to eliminate left recursion in ArgList:
            # ArgList -> E (',' E)*
            "ArgListTail": [(",", "E", "ArgListTail"), ()],
        },
        nonterminals={
            "E",
            "E_prime",
            "T",
            "T_prime",
            "F",
            "OptArgs",
            "ArgList",
            "ArgListTail",
        },
    )
    nullable = compute_nullable(g)
    first = compute_first(g, nullable)
    follow = compute_follow(g, nullable, first)

    # Invariants for expression language:
    # 1. E can be followed by:
    #    - '$' (from start symbol S)
    #    - ')' (from F -> ( E ) and F -> id ( OptArgs ) via ArgList -> E)
    #    - ',' (from ArgListTail -> , E)
    assert follow["E"] == frozenset({"$", ")", ","}), f"Actual FOLLOW(E): {follow['E']}"
    assert follow["E_prime"] == follow["E"]

    # 2. T is followed by FIRST(E') \ {eps} = {+, -}, plus FOLLOW(E') because E' is nullable
    assert follow["T"] == frozenset({"+", "-", "$", ")", ","})
    assert follow["T_prime"] == follow["T"]

    # 3. F is followed by FIRST(T') \ {eps} = {*, /}, plus FOLLOW(T') because T' is nullable
    assert follow["F"] == frozenset({"*", "/", "+", "-", "$", ")", ","})

    # 4. OptArgs appears strictly before ')' in F -> id ( OptArgs )
    assert follow["OptArgs"] == frozenset({")"})
    assert follow["ArgList"] == frozenset({")"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_order_reversal_necessitates_multiple_passes():
    test_cyclic_mutual_recursion_follow()
    test_expression_language_follow_sets()
    print("All FOLLOW derivation and fixed-point unit tests passed successfully.")

1. Bounded-Trace Policy for Predictive ParsersA standard deterministic LL(1) parse consumes input on terminal matches and substitutes nonterminals on expansions. However, if a table is improperly constructed or derived from a malformed/non-LL(1) grammar containing left-recursion or cycles, the parser can enter non-terminating loops without consuming input (e.g., A \to B \to A via empty productions or circular rewrites).To ensure safety and termination against malformed parsing tables:Global Step Bound: Let N be the number of input tokens, |V_N| the number of nonterminals, and |P| the total number of grammar productions. The maximum allowable non-terminal expansions without consuming a token is bounded by |V_N|. Any derivation chain of length > |V_N| without consuming a terminal implies a cycle in the predictive table.Absolute Derivation Step Limit: The total number of parse steps is strictly capped at:\text{MAX\_STEPS} = c_1 \cdot N + c_2 \cdot |V_N|where default constants are c_1 = 50, c_2 = 100. Exceeding this bound raises a ParseLoopError.Stack Depth Limit: The maximum depth of the parse stack is capped at \text{MAX\_STACK\_DEPTH} = 1000 to catch unbounded right-growth early.2. Standalone Table-Driven LL(1) Parser Implementationfrom dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import NamedTuple


class ParseStep(NamedTuple):
    step: int
    stack: list[str]
    lookahead: str
    action: str


@dataclass
class ParseResult:
    success: bool
    trace: list[ParseStep]
    error_message: str | None = None


class ParseError(Exception):
    pass


class ParseLoopError(ParseError):
    pass


class LL1TableDrivenParser:
    def __init__(
        self,
        table: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[str, ...]],
        start_symbol: str,
        terminals: set[str],
        nonterminals: set[str],
        endmarker: str = "$",
        max_steps: int = 500,
        max_stack_depth: int = 200,
    ):
        self.table = table
        self.start_symbol = start_symbol
        self.terminals = terminals
        self.nonterminals = nonterminals
        self.endmarker = endmarker
        self.max_steps = max_steps
        self.max_stack_depth = max_stack_depth

    def parse(self, tokens: list[str]) -> ParseResult:
        trace: list[ParseStep] = []
        input_stream = list(tokens) + [self.endmarker]
        stack: list[str] = [self.endmarker, self.start_symbol]
        
        cursor = 0
        step_count = 0
        expansions_without_consumption = 0

        while len(stack) > 0:
            step_count += 1
            current_lookahead = input_stream[cursor]

            # Enforce bounded-trace policy
            if step_count > self.max_steps:
                err = f"Bounded-trace limit exceeded ({self.max_steps} steps). Potential infinite expansion loop."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            if len(stack) > self.max_stack_depth:
                err = f"Maximum stack depth ({self.max_stack_depth}) exceeded."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            top = stack[-1]

            # 1. Lexical sanity check on lookahead
            if current_lookahead not in self.terminals and current_lookahead != self.endmarker:
                err = f"Lexical error: Unrecognized token '{current_lookahead}'."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            # 2. Both stack top and lookahead are endmarker -> Successful acceptance
            if top == self.endmarker and current_lookahead == self.endmarker:
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, "ACCEPT"))
                stack.pop()
                return ParseResult(success=True, trace=trace)

            # 3. Stack top is terminal
            if top in self.terminals or top == self.endmarker:
                if top == current_lookahead:
                    action_desc = f"MATCH '{current_lookahead}'"
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, action_desc))
                    stack.pop()
                    cursor += 1
                    expansions_without_consumption = 0
                else:
                    err = f"Syntax error: Terminal mismatch. Expected '{top}', found '{current_lookahead}'."
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                    return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            # 4. Stack top is nonterminal
            elif top in self.nonterminals:
                lookup_key = (top, current_lookahead)
                if lookup_key not in self.table:
                    err = f"Syntax error: No table transition for [{top}, '{current_lookahead}']."
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                    return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

                production = self.table[lookup_key]
                stack.pop()
                expansions_without_consumption += 1

                # Loop prevention: cycle detection without consumption
                if expansions_without_consumption > len(self.nonterminals):
                    err = "Grammar error: Circular null-expansion chain detected without consuming input."
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                    return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

                # Push symbols in reverse order (empty production pushes nothing)
                if production != ():
                    for sym in reversed(production):
                        stack.append(sym)
                    prod_str = " ".join(production)
                else:
                    prod_str = "ε"

                action_desc = f"EXPAND {top} -> {prod_str}"
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, action_desc))

            else:
                err = f"Internal error: Symbol '{top}' is neither terminal nor nonterminal."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

        return ParseResult(success=True, trace=trace)


def print_trace(result: ParseResult, input_tokens: list[str]) -> None:
    print(f"\n--- Trace for input: {' '.join(input_tokens)} ---")
    header = f"{'Step':<5} | {'Stack (Bottom -> Top)':<35} | {'Lookahead':<10} | {'Action'}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header) + "-" * 30)

    for step in result.trace:
        stack_repr = " ".join(step.stack)
        print(f"{step.step:<5} | {stack_repr:<35} | {step.lookahead:<10} | {step.action}")

    if result.success:
        print("[Status] PARSE SUCCEEDED.")
    else:
        print(f"[Status] PARSE FAILED: {result.error_message}")

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import NamedTuple


class ParseStep(NamedTuple):
    step: int
    stack: list[str]
    lookahead: str
    action: str


@dataclass
class ParseResult:
    success: bool
    trace: list[ParseStep]
    error_message: str | None = None


class ParseError(Exception):
    pass


class ParseLoopError(ParseError):
    pass


class LL1TableDrivenParser:
    def __init__(
        self,
        table: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[str, ...]],
        start_symbol: str,
        terminals: set[str],
        nonterminals: set[str],
        endmarker: str = "$",
        max_steps: int = 500,
        max_stack_depth: int = 200,
    ):
        self.table = table
        self.start_symbol = start_symbol
        self.terminals = terminals
        self.nonterminals = nonterminals
        self.endmarker = endmarker
        self.max_steps = max_steps
        self.max_stack_depth = max_stack_depth

    def parse(self, tokens: list[str]) -> ParseResult:
        trace: list[ParseStep] = []
        input_stream = list(tokens) + [self.endmarker]
        stack: list[str] = [self.endmarker, self.start_symbol]
        
        cursor = 0
        step_count = 0
        expansions_without_consumption = 0

        while len(stack) > 0:
            step_count += 1
            current_lookahead = input_stream[cursor]

            # Enforce bounded-trace policy
            if step_count > self.max_steps:
                err = f"Bounded-trace limit exceeded ({self.max_steps} steps). Potential infinite expansion loop."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            if len(stack) > self.max_stack_depth:
                err = f"Maximum stack depth ({self.max_stack_depth}) exceeded."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            top = stack[-1]

            # 1. Lexical sanity check on lookahead
            if current_lookahead not in self.terminals and current_lookahead != self.endmarker:
                err = f"Lexical error: Unrecognized token '{current_lookahead}'."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            # 2. Both stack top and lookahead are endmarker -> Successful acceptance
            if top == self.endmarker and current_lookahead == self.endmarker:
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, "ACCEPT"))
                stack.pop()
                return ParseResult(success=True, trace=trace)

            # 3. Stack top is terminal
            if top in self.terminals or top == self.endmarker:
                if top == current_lookahead:
                    action_desc = f"MATCH '{current_lookahead}'"
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, action_desc))
                    stack.pop()
                    cursor += 1
                    expansions_without_consumption = 0
                else:
                    err = f"Syntax error: Terminal mismatch. Expected '{top}', found '{current_lookahead}'."
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                    return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

            # 4. Stack top is nonterminal
            elif top in self.nonterminals:
                lookup_key = (top, current_lookahead)
                if lookup_key not in self.table:
                    err = f"Syntax error: No table transition for [{top}, '{current_lookahead}']."
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                    return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

                production = self.table[lookup_key]
                stack.pop()
                expansions_without_consumption += 1

                # Loop prevention: cycle detection without consumption
                if expansions_without_consumption > len(self.nonterminals):
                    err = "Grammar error: Circular null-expansion chain detected without consuming input."
                    trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                    return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

                # Push symbols in reverse order (empty production pushes nothing)
                if production != ():
                    for sym in reversed(production):
                        stack.append(sym)
                    prod_str = " ".join(production)
                else:
                    prod_str = "ε"

                action_desc = f"EXPAND {top} -> {prod_str}"
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, action_desc))

            else:
                err = f"Internal error: Symbol '{top}' is neither terminal nor nonterminal."
                trace.append(ParseStep(step_count, list(stack), current_lookahead, f"ERROR: {err}"))
                return ParseResult(success=False, trace=trace, error_message=err)

        return ParseResult(success=True, trace=trace)


def print_trace(result: ParseResult, input_tokens: list[str]) -> None:
    print(f"\n--- Trace for input: {' '.join(input_tokens)} ---")
    header = f"{'Step':<5} | {'Stack (Bottom -> Top)':<35} | {'Lookahead':<10} | {'Action'}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header) + "-" * 30)

    for step in result.trace:
        stack_repr = " ".join(step.stack)
        print(f"{step.step:<5} | {stack_repr:<35} | {step.lookahead:<10} | {step.action}")

    if result.success:
        print("[Status] PARSE SUCCEEDED.")
    else:
        print(f"[Status] PARSE FAILED: {result.error_message}")
